lines.personal_line: We have great respect for the way your team keeps guest rooms stocked with trusted biscuits and sweets for the accommodation industry. Many hotel guests look for a lighter choice in their room, and we believe sugar free biscuits and sweets may suit those very same guests. We would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss whether this could be a worthwhile addition to your range.
lines.company_note: supplies guest room biscuits and sweets to hotels and accommodation providers
